competitorChecks.label: PC Gamer - 99 Nights in the Forest tips

notes: Crafted utility rows keep requirement detail light because the Crafting catalog owns full recipe progression.

Rod and flute upgrade routes use Tool Trader as the current route because Beebom says the old Upgrade Station was removed and replaced by the Tool Trader, and the Fandom Tool Trader page says he has an upgrade stand for rods and flutes.
Axe Trim Kit is not a row because it is a one-time upgrade material; its source-backed effect is captured in axe upgradeRoute and capacityOrStat fields.
Admin/update-party rows are separated by category and availability so they do not look like normal run goals.

items.name: Old Sack
items.effect: Stores carried items.
items.capacityOrStat: 5 item capacity; 7 with Scavenger or Explorer sack bonus.
items.source: Starting item.
items.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed; replace it with a higher-capacity sack from chests or the Pelt Trader.
items.requirement: None.
items.bestFor: Starter carrying before the first Good Sack route.
items.sourceNote: Sacks source lists Old Sack as the starting sack and gives its base and class-boosted capacity.

items.name: Good Sack
items.effect: Stores carried items with triple the Old Sack base capacity.
items.capacityOrStat: 15 item capacity; 17 with Scavenger or Explorer sack bonus.
items.source: Common Chests, Good Chests, Iron Chests, or Pelt Trader first trade.
items.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed; replace it with Infernal Sack or Giant Sack later.
items.requirement: Chest drop or Pelt Trader first trade.
items.bestFor: Early looting, wood hauling, and first Pelt Trader priority.
items.sourceNote: Sacks source says Good Sack is obtainable from multiple chest types and the Pelt Trader first trade.

items.name: Infernal Sack
items.effect: Stores items and cooks raw meat placed inside.
items.capacityOrStat: 20 item capacity; 22 with Scavenger or Explorer sack bonus.
items.source: Infernal Chests in the Volcanic Biome or Cultist King drop chance.
items.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed; Giant Sack has more capacity but does not list the auto-cook effect.
items.requirement: Reach Volcanic Biome Infernal Chests or defeat Cultist King.
items.bestFor: Long trips where carried raw meat can become cooked food.
items.availability: Normal run; biome or boss gated
items.sourceNote: Sacks source lists Infernal Chests and Cultist King as sources and notes the meat-cooking effect.

items.name: Giant Sack
items.effect: Stores the largest normal sack load.
items.capacityOrStat: 25 item capacity; 27 with Scavenger or Explorer sack bonus.
items.source: Legendary Chests, Gold Chests, or Pelt Trader third trade.
items.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed.
items.requirement: Late chest source or Pelt Trader third trade.
items.bestFor: Large loot trips, late wood hauling, and fewer returns to camp.
items.sourceNote: Sacks source lists Giant Sack sources and capacity; Sacks tips also note the Pelt Trader option can depend on flashlight state.

items.name: Old Axe
items.effect: Cuts trees and damages entities.
items.capacityOrStat: 13 hits to chop a normal tree; 7 hits after Axe Trim Kit.
items.source: Starting item, except when Lumberjack replaces it with Good Axe.
items.upgradeRoute: Can be improved with Axe Trim Kit.
items.requirement: None.
items.bestFor: Starting wood collection before a Good Axe or better axe is found.
items.sourceNote: Axes source lists Old Axe as a starting item and gives normal and trimmed chop counts.

items.name: Good Axe
items.effect: Cuts trees, damages entities, and can break ice around Ice Chests.
items.capacityOrStat: 5 hits to chop a normal tree; about 5-7 hits for Ice Chest ice; 4 tree hits after Axe Trim Kit.
items.source: Pelt Trader first trade, Common Chests, Good Chests, or Lumberjack class.
items.upgradeRoute: Can be improved with Axe Trim Kit.
items.requirement: Chest source, Pelt Trader first trade, or Lumberjack class.
items.bestFor: Early wood speed and first ice-breaking utility.
items.sourceNote: Axes source lists Good Axe sources, tree hits, ice use, and trimmed tree-hit count.

items.name: Ice Axe
items.effect: Cuts trees, damages entities, slows hit entities, and breaks ice around cold chests.
items.capacityOrStat: 5 hits to chop a normal tree; about 5 hits for Ice Chest ice; cannot use Axe Trim Kit.
items.source: Cold Chests or Ice Chests in the Snow Biome.
items.upgradeRoute: Axe Trim Kit cannot be used on this axe.
items.requirement: Snow Biome cold or ice chest source.
items.bestFor: Snow Biome routing and slowing threats while chopping or escaping.
items.sourceNote: Axes source lists Ice Axe chest sources, slow effect, ice utility, and trim-kit exclusion.

items.name: Strong Axe
items.effect: Cuts trees, big trees, and ice faster than earlier axes.
items.capacityOrStat: 1 hit for a normal tree; 35 hits for a big tree; 3 hits for Ice Chest ice; 33 big-tree hits after Axe Trim Kit.
items.source: Pelt Trader fourth trade, Legendary Chests, or Gold Chests.
items.upgradeRoute: Can be improved with Axe Trim Kit.
items.requirement: Late chest source or Pelt Trader fourth trade.
items.bestFor: Late wood routes, big trees, ice, and Hard Mode rift cleanup setup.
items.sourceNote: Axes and Hard Mode sources both point to Strong Axe as important for big trees and corrupted-tree cleanup.

items.name: Chainsaw
items.effect: Cuts continuously while held and damages entities.
items.capacityOrStat: 2 ticks for a normal tree; 38 ticks for a big tree; 35 big-tree ticks after Axe Trim Kit.
items.source: Ruby Chests or Tool Workshop.
items.upgradeRoute: Can be improved with Axe Trim Kit.
items.requirement: Workshop craft uses Cultist Gems, Bear Pelts, Alpha Wolf Pelts, Bunny Feet, and Scrap; exact recipe belongs with Crafting.
items.bestFor: Continuous chopping and late-run tree clearing when a workshop or Ruby Chest route is available.
items.availability: Normal run; workshop or late chest gated
items.sourceNote: Axes source lists Ruby Chest and Workshop sources, continuous use, and full recipe; dataset keeps recipe detail light.

items.name: Old Rod
items.effect: Lets players fish from ponds for fish, resources, and other items.
items.capacityOrStat: Level 1 fishing rod.
items.source: Fishing Cabin or Fishing Hut, Tool Trader, chests, or Fisherman class.
items.upgradeRoute: Gain rod XP by successfully fishing, then upgrade at the Tool Trader workshop after the XP bar fills.
items.requirement: Find one from a fishing structure or chest, start as Fisherman, or buy from Tool Trader for 20 Mossy Coins.
items.bestFor: Starting the fishing route for food, scrap, ammo, bandages, and rare fishing rewards.
items.sourceNote: Fishing and Fishing Rod sources list fishing structures, chests, and Fisherman class; Beebom and Fandom Tool Trader identify Tool Trader as the current buy and upgrade route after the old upgrade system changed.

items.name: Good Rod
items.effect: Makes fishing easier than Old Rod.
items.capacityOrStat: Level 2 fishing rod.
items.source: Upgrade an Old Rod after filling rod XP.
items.upgradeRoute: Upgrade Old Rod at the Tool Trader workshop after the rod XP bar fills.
items.requirement: Old Rod with enough rod XP.
items.bestFor: Mid fishing after the first rod XP bar is finished.
items.sourceNote: Fishing/Fishing Rod pages explain the XP upgrade chain. Beebom says the old Upgrade Station was removed and the Tool Trader replaced it; dataset uses Tool Trader as the current upgrade route.

items.name: Strong Rod
items.effect: Makes fishing easier than Good Rod.
items.capacityOrStat: Level 3 fishing rod; maximum rod level listed.
items.source: Upgrade a Good Rod after filling rod XP.
items.upgradeRoute: Final listed rod upgrade at the Tool Trader workshop after the rod XP bar fills.
items.requirement: Good Rod at max XP.
items.bestFor: Harder catches and longer fishing-focused routes.
items.sourceNote: Fishing Rod source lists maximum level 3; Fishing source explains XP-based rod upgrades; Beebom resolves current upgrade location to the Tool Trader workshop.

items.name: Old Taming Flute
items.effect: Starts the animal taming minigame and shows nearby tamed animal hearts when held.
items.capacityOrStat: Can tame animals listed with 1-3 hearts or faces.
items.source: Abandoned Animal Shelter or Domestication Cabin, Tool Trader, Zookeeper class, and source-listed Pelt Trader second trade.
items.upgradeRoute: Gain flute XP through taming or healing tamed animals, then upgrade at the Tool Trader workshop.
items.requirement: Find one from the animal shelter/cabin route, start as Zookeeper, buy from Tool Trader for 20 Mossy Coins, or use the source-listed Pelt Trader route.
items.bestFor: Starting bunny, kiwi, frog, scorpion, or wolf taming routes.
items.sourceNote: Taming Flute source lists Abandoned Animal Shelter, Pelt Trader, Zookeeper, and Tool Trader. Beebom calls the shelter route Domestication Cabin and confirms Tool Trader sells flutes for 20 Mossy Coins.

items.name: Good Taming Flute
items.effect: Tames stronger animals than Old Taming Flute and shows nearby tamed animal hearts when held.
items.capacityOrStat: Can tame animals listed with 3-4 hearts or faces.
items.source: Upgrade an Old Taming Flute at the Tool Trader workshop.
items.upgradeRoute: Upgrade Old Taming Flute at the Tool Trader workshop after enough flute XP.
items.requirement: Old Taming Flute with enough flute XP.
items.bestFor: Mid taming routes such as Arctic Fox and Alpha Wolf.
items.sourceNote: Taming Flute source confirms Good Taming Flute as the second flute tier. Beebom and Fandom Tool Trader resolve the current upgrade location to the Tool Trader workshop.

items.name: Strong Taming Flute
items.effect: Tames the strongest listed animals and can raise pet capacity for most classes.
items.capacityOrStat: Can tame animals listed with 5 hearts or faces; increases pet capacity by 1 except for Zookeeper, Beastmaster, and Necromancer.
items.source: Upgrade a Good Taming Flute.
items.upgradeRoute: Final listed flute upgrade at the Tool Trader workshop after enough flute XP.
items.requirement: Good Taming Flute upgrade progress.
items.bestFor: Bear, Polar Bear, Mammoth, Mossy Mammoth, and Hellephant taming routes.
items.sourceNote: Taming Flute source lists the pet-capacity exception and the Strong Flute animal tier. Current upgrade route is recorded as Tool Trader based on Beebom and Fandom Tool Trader.

items.name: Old Flashlight
items.effect: Lights the night and can stun The Deer, The Owl, and The Ram.
items.capacityOrStat: Old Flashlight max charge is listed as 50%.
items.source: Chests, Pelt Trader first trade, or Watch Tower.
items.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed; replace with Strong Flashlight.
items.requirement: Chest, Watch Tower, or Pelt Trader source.
items.bestFor: Basic night vision and emergency monster stuns.
items.sourceNote: Flashlights source lists stun targets, recharge at Campfire or fireflies, and Old Flashlight charge limit.

items.name: Strong Flashlight
items.effect: Lights farther and stuns The Deer, The Owl, and The Ram longer than Old Flashlight.
items.capacityOrStat: Strong Flashlight max charge is listed as 100%.
items.source: Iron Chests, Legendary Chests, Gold Chests, or Pelt Trader third trade.
items.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed.
items.requirement: Better chest source or Pelt Trader third trade.
items.bestFor: Night exploration, longer stun windows, and safer travel away from camp.
items.sourceNote: Flashlights source lists the stronger light, longer stun, and larger battery compared with Old Flashlight.

items.name: Hammer
items.effect: Moves structures and many decorations around camp.
items.capacityOrStat: Cannot move the Teleporter or defensive blueprints such as Barbed Wire and Stakes.
items.source: Tool Workshop, Decorator class, Blacksmith class, or Engineer class.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: Tool Workshop craft uses 5 Logs and 5 Scrap.
items.bestFor: Camp layout fixes, furniture moving, and decoration pickup.
items.availability: Normal run; class or workshop source
items.sourceNote: Hammer source lists class starters, workshop recipe, and limits on what it can pick up.

items.name: Paint Brush
items.effect: Repaints selected furniture at the campfire base.
items.capacityOrStat: 32 colors listed; most furniture cannot be painted except beanbags, cushions, and cloth frame.
items.source: Decorator class, side of the Horse carriage, and Decorator Gamepass source listed by the wiki.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: Class, Horse carriage, or listed gamepass source.
items.bestFor: Cosmetic base decoration rather than survival routing.
items.sourceNote: Paint Brush source lists repaint behavior, color count, sources, and furniture limits. This row does not create or endorse a gamepass page.

items.name: Map
items.effect: Shows the full map, important locations, and explored or unexplored areas.
items.capacityOrStat: Craftable max 1.
items.source: Crafting Bench Tier 1.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: 3 Wood.
items.bestFor: Early navigation and planning unexplored routes.
items.sourceNote: The Map source says it is crafted for 3 Wood and can be paired with Compass for easier navigation.

items.name: Sun Dial
items.effect: Shows how much time is left until day or night.
items.capacityOrStat: Timer appears in the top-right screen area after crafting.
items.source: Crafting Bench Tier 2.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: 5 Scrap.
items.bestFor: Leaving enough time to return to camp before night.
items.sourceNote: Crafting source spells the row as Sun Dial; Days source also describes Sundial day/night timer use.

items.name: Compass
items.effect: Shows direction to the Fairy and missing children and shows where the player is facing.
items.capacityOrStat: Top-right screen utility after crafting.
items.source: Crafting Bench Tier 2.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: 3 Scrap.
items.bestFor: Rescue routing and objective direction checks.
items.sourceNote: Crafting source lists Fairy, missing child, and facing direction information.

items.name: Radar
items.effect: Detects key places in the forest by using Scrap.
items.capacityOrStat: Uses Scrap to detect key locations.
items.source: Crafting Bench Tier 3.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: 15 Wood and 10 Scrap.
items.bestFor: Finding important locations after basic map tools are built.
items.sourceNote: Crafting source row appears as Rader, but the linked file and normal item name are Radar.

items.name: Lightning Rod
items.effect: Attracts lightning so it does not strike the player.
items.capacityOrStat: Can be placed more than once; Crafting tips say one is usually enough.
items.source: Crafting Bench Tier 3.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: 8 Scrap.
items.bestFor: Storm safety around base or routes where lightning is a risk.
items.sourceNote: Crafting source describes lightning attraction and repeat placement.

items.name: Teleporter
items.effect: Allows teleporting across the map when two or more Teleporters are placed.
items.capacityOrStat: Requires two or more Teleporters to work; can be placed more than once.
items.source: Crafting Bench Tier 4.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed; Hammer source says Teleporter cannot be picked up with Hammer.
items.requirement: 15 Wood, 25 Scrap, and 1 Cultist Gem.
items.bestFor: Long-distance travel, rift cleanup, and returning between far objectives.
items.sourceNote: Crafting source lists Teleporter effect, placement rule, and materials; Hammer source lists movement limitation.

items.name: Respawn Capsule
items.effect: Automatically respawns the most recent dead player inside it after charging.
items.capacityOrStat: Must charge before the respawn effect triggers.
items.source: Crafting Bench Tier 5.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: 40 Wood, 40 Scrap, and 1 Gem of the Forest.
items.bestFor: Team recovery on long runs where a death would otherwise cost the route.
items.sourceNote: Crafting source lists Respawn Capsule effect and materials.

items.name: Temporal Accelerometer
items.effect: Skips the next night once charged.
items.capacityOrStat: Night-skip device; Days source calls it highly valuable for speedruns.
items.source: Crafting Bench Tier 5.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: 40 Wood, 40 Scrap, and 1 Gem of the Forest; Days source also notes a Cultist Gem cost per use.
items.bestFor: Speedruns and skipping dangerous nights after late crafting setup.
items.sourceNote: Crafting source lists craft materials and charge effect; Days source adds speedrun value and a per-use Cultist Gem note.

items.name: Corrupted Axe
items.effect: Hard Mode corrupted axe with Strong Axe-like tree-chopping utility and limited corruption meter use.
items.capacityOrStat: Equivalent to Strong Axe tree-chopping speed; explodes when its corruption meter reaches 100%.
items.source: Corrupted Chests during Hard Mode.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed; when used up it permanently increases map corruption by 10%.
items.requirement: Hard Mode corruption event and corrupted chest source.
items.bestFor: Temporary rift and corrupted-tree cleanup when a normal Strong Axe or Chainsaw route is not ready.
items.sourceNote: Hard Mode source marks Corrupted Axe as a corrupted chest item and warns it can replace a Strong Axe and explode after use.

items.name: Admin Sack
items.effect: Admin-only sack with extreme carrying capacity.
items.capacityOrStat: 99,999 item capacity; Admin Items source says 100,001 with Scavenger.
items.source: Update Party/admin-spawned item.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: Admin or Update Party availability only.
items.bestFor: Reference only; not a normal progression target.
items.sourceNote: Sacks and Admin Items sources both list Admin Sack as an Update Party/admin item.

items.name: Admin Axe
items.effect: Admin-only axe that instantly kills many entities and can one-hit trees.
items.capacityOrStat: Admin Items source excludes Mega Cultists, Evil Bunnies, and Evil Carrots from instant kill.
items.source: Update Party/admin-spawned item.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: Admin or Update Party availability only.
items.bestFor: Reference only; not a normal chopping or combat goal.
items.sourceNote: Admin Items source lists instant-kill behavior; Axes source says Admin Axe is not obtainable outside Update Party.

items.name: Admin Flashlight
items.effect: Admin-only light that lasts infinitely, shines extremely bright, and burns entities it shines on.
items.capacityOrStat: Infinite duration listed by Admin Items source.
items.source: Update Party/admin-spawned item.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: Admin or Update Party availability only.
items.bestFor: Reference only; not a normal night-safety target.
items.sourceNote: Admin Items source lists the Admin Flashlight effect; Flashlights source says it used the Strong Flashlight body and texture.
items.imageStatus: local source image present; source reuses Strong Flashlight art

items.name: Admin Taming Flute
items.effect: Admin-only flute that instantly tames animals.
items.capacityOrStat: Can tame a maximum of 200 animals instantly.
items.source: Update Party/admin-spawned item.
items.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
items.requirement: Admin or Update Party availability only.
items.bestFor: Reference only; not a normal taming route.
items.sourceNote: Admin Items source lists Admin Taming Flute and its instant tame limit.
